name: Shajar al-Durr

checks.lead: Shajar al-Durr (Arabic: شجر الدر, lit. 'Tree of Pearls'), also Shajarat al-Durr (شجرة الدر), whose royal name was al-Malika ʿAṣmat ad-Dīn ʾUmm-Khalīl Shajar ad-Durr (الملكة عصمة الدين أم خليل شجر الدر; died 28 April 1257), was a ruler of Egypt, and the first sultan of the Bahri dynasty of Egypt. She was the wife of As-Salih Ayyub, and later of Izz al-Din Aybak, Prior to becoming Ayyub's wife, she was a child slave and Ayyub's concubine. She was of Turkic origin.
